title: Color $2$-switches and neighborhood $λ$-balanced graphs with $k$ colors
summary: This paper examines vertex colorings of graphs with constraints on the distribution of colors in vertex neighborhoods. We introduce color 2-switches and color degree matrices. The color degree matrix of a $k$-colored graph is an analog of the degree sequence, while a color 2-switch provides a way to transform a $k$-colored graph to another such graph while maintaining the color of each vertex and the multiset of colors in each vertex neighborhood.
